name: trassd-shopware
description: Skills and agents that enforce Shopware 6 plugin and app best practices: plugin scaffolding & lifecycle, dependency injection, DAL entities & associations, database migrations, events & subscribers, Store-API routes, Storefront controllers, templates & JavaScript components, Administration modules/components, scheduled tasks & messaging, Shopware Apps (manifest, registration & webhooks, Twig app scripts, Meteor Admin SDK), Storefront themes (theme.json, inheritance, SCSS), the platform's Architecture Decision Records (ADRs), plus a Store quality gate.
